title: Baseline provenance addendum
description: sources/graph/anchors/baseline-provenance.json: classes for baseline sentences the provenance record's clause table cannot classify (sentences a later revision adds, and sentences outside its extraction pattern that its prose classifies), judged with the record's method. Keyed by sentence sha256; it holds no baseline text. An entry applies from its from_revision on, in the manifest's revision order; pin-baseline records the applied entries of a revision by count and by a digest that also covers the basis they cite, so an entry a pinned revision used never changes. Classes: baseline-text (his words, not a restrictive clause), founder-clause (his words, a restrictive clause), agent-fence (git holds no founder quote for it, or names it an agent reading), unclear (git cannot tell).

method.description: the provenance record whose method and evidence codes the entries follow

codes.description: evidence codes this file adds to the record's E1-E7, each with its meaning

basis.description: git evidence the entries cite by key: a file at a revision with its sha256, or a commit's message

reason.description: the agent's reason in its own words; never baseline or founder wording
